F. Inboard Aft Flap Actuating Mechanism Installation
SUBTASK 27-51-14-420-001
(1) Install the inboard bellcrank assembly [67]:
(a) Put the inboard bellcrank assembly [67] in its position in the main flap [1].
(b) Install the bushings [70], bolt [68], washer [69], washer [71] and nut [72] to attach the
inboard bellcrank assembly [67].
NOTE: Install the bolt [68] with the head down.
EFFECTIVITY
 ALL
(c) Tighten the nut [72] to 100 in-lb (11.3 N·m)-150 in-lb (16.9 N·m).
(d) Install the pin [73] in the nut [72].
SUBTASK 27-51-14-420-002
(2) Install the outboard bellcrank assembly [33]:
(a) Put the outboard bellcrank assembly [33] in its position in the main flap [1].
(b) Install the bushings [7], bolt [5], washer [6], washer [8] and nut [9] to attach the outboard
bellcrank assembly [33].
NOTE: Install the bolt [5] with the head up.
(c) Tighten the nut [9] to 100 in-lb (11.3 N·m)-150 in-lb (16.9 N·m).
(d) Install the pin [10] in the nut [9].
SUBTASK 27-51-14-420-003
(3) Install the cable assemblies [19] and cable assemblies [64]:
(a) Put the cable assemblies [19] and cable assemblies [64] in their position in the main
flap [1].
(b) Install the bolts [35], washers [36], washers [37], teflon washers [90] (if removed) and
nuts [38] to attach the cable assemblies [19] to the outboard bellcrank assembly [33].
(c) Install the bolts [59], washers [60], washers [61], teflon washers [90] (if removed) and
nuts [62] to attach the cable assemblies [64] to the inboard bellcrank assembly [67].
(d) Tighten the nuts [38] and nuts [62] to 50 in-lb (5.6 N·m)-80 in-lb (9 N·m).
(e) Install the pins [39] in the nuts [38].
(f) Install the pins [63] in the nuts [62].
(g) Connect the cable assemblies [19] and cable assemblies [64] together at the
turnbuckles [65].
NOTE: Do not tighten the turnbuckles [65] or install the locking clips [66] at this time.
SUBTASK 27-51-14-420-004
(4) Install the crankshaft assembly [17]:
(a) Put the crankshaft assembly [17] in its position between the ribs [41] on the leading edge
of the main flap [1].
(b) Install the bushings [53], bolt [51], washer [52], washer [54], and nut [55] that attach the
crankshaft assembly [17] to the ribs [41].
(c) Tighten the nut [55] to 160 in-lb (18.1 N·m)-240 in-lb (27.1 N·m).
(d) Install the pin [56] in the nut [55].
SUBTASK 27-51-14-420-005
(5) Install the interconnect push rod assembly [18]:
(a) Put the interconnect push rod assembly [18] in its position between the crankshaft
assembly [17] and the outboard bellcrank assembly [33].
(b) Install the bushing [13], bolt [11], washer [12], washer [14] and nut [15] that attach the
interconnect push rod assembly [18] to the crankshaft assembly [17].
NOTE: Install the bolt [11] with the head outboard.
(c) Install the bushing [23], bolt [21], washer [22], washer [24] and nut [25] that attach the
interconnect push rod assembly [18] to the outboard bellcrank assembly [33].
NOTE: Install the bolt [21] with the head up.
EFFECTIVITY
 ALL
(d) Tighten the nut [15] and nut [25] to 50 in-lb (5.6 N·m)-80 in-lb (9.0 N·m).
(e) Install the pin [16] in the nut [15].
(f) Install the pin [26] in the nut [25].
SUBTASK 27-51-14-820-001
(6) Adjust the interconnect push rod assembly [18], cable assemblies [19] and cable
assemblies [64]:
(a) Move the crankshaft assembly [17] to the retracted position.
(b) Install the rig pin from the rigging pin kit, SPL-1585 in the crankshaft assembly [17].
NOTE: Use rig pin F70207–113 or F70207–114.
(c) Install the rig pin from the rigging pin kit, SPL-1585 in the outboard bellcrank
assembly [33].
NOTE: Use rig pin F70207–113 or F70207–114.
(d) If you cannot install the rig pin in the outboard bellcrank assembly [33], adjust the length
of the interconnect push rod assembly [18]:
1) Loosen the nuts [20] on the interconnect push rod assembly [18].
2) Turn the interconnect push rod assembly [18] until you can install the rig pin in the
outboard bellcrank assembly [33].
3) Tighten the nuts [20] on the interconnect push rod assembly [18].
4) Install lockwire on the nuts [20].
(e) Install the rig pin from the rigging pin kit, SPL-1585 in the inboard bellcrank
assembly [67].
NOTE: Use rig pin F70207–113 or F70207–114.
(f) If you cannot install the rig pin in the inboard bellcrank assembly [67], adjust the cables:
1) Remove the rig pin from the rigging pin kit, SPL-1585 from the crankshaft
assembly [17].
2) If it is necessary, remove the tension from the forward cable assembly [19] and
cable assembly [64]:
a) Remove the locking clips [66] from the turnbuckles [65].
b) Turn the turnbuckles [65].
3) Install the rig pin from the rigging pin kit, SPL-1585 in the inboard bellcrank
assembly [67] and the outboard bellcrank assembly [33].
NOTE: Use rig pin F70207–113 or F70207–114.
4) Use a high tension cable tensiometer, COM-1554 to adjust the tension in the aft
cable assembly [19] until it is in the limit of 200 lbf (890 N)±25 lbf (111 N).
NOTE: The cable is 3/16” (0.1875 in. (4.7625 mm)) diameter.
5) Use a high tension cable tensiometer, COM-1554 to adjust the tension in the
forward cable assembly [19] until you can easily remove and install the rig pins in
the bellcranks.
a) Make sure that the tension in the aft cable assembly [19] stays in the limit.
NOTE: The cable is 3/16” (0.1875 in. (4.7625 mm)) diameter.
(g) Install the locking clips [66] in the turnbuckles [65] for the cable assemblies [19] and cable
assemblies [64].
EFFECTIVITY
 ALL
(h) Remove the rig pins from the inboard bellcrank assembly [67], outboard bellcrank
assembly [33] and the crankshaft assembly [17].
SUBTASK 27-51-14-420-006
(7) Install the aft flap push rod assemblies [34]:
(a) Put the aft flap push rod assemblies [34] in their location between the aft flap [2] and the
bellcranks.
(b) Install the bolt [27], washer [28], bushing [29], washer [30] and nut [31] that attach the
inboard aft flap push rod assembly [34] to the inboard bellcrank assembly [67].
(c) Install the bushing [29], bolt [27], washer [28], washer [30] and nut [31] that attach the
outboard aft flap push rod assembly [34] to the outboard bellcrank assembly [33].
(d) Install the bushings [77], bolts [75], washers [76], washers [78] and nuts [79] that attach
the aft flap push rod assemblies [34] to the aft flap [2].
(e) Tighten the nuts [31] and nuts [79] to 50 in-lb (5.6 N·m)-80 in-lb (9.0 N·m).
(f) Install pins [32] in the nuts [31].
(g) Install pins [80] in the nuts [79].
SUBTASK 27-51-14-820-002
(8) If the aft flap [2] is installed, do an adjustment of the aft flap push rod assemblies [34]:
(a) Use the crankshaft assembly [17] to manually move the aft flap [2] to the retracted
position.
(b) Install the rig pin from the rigging pin kit, SPL-1585 in the crankshaft assembly [17].
NOTE: Use rig pin F70207–113 or F70207–114.
(c) Measure the distance between the trailing edge of the aft flap [2] and the trailing edge of
the upper cove panel [101] on the main flap [1] (Figure 402).
NOTE: Measure the distance aft of the inboard and outboard aft flap push rod
assemblies [34].
1) At the outboard push rod assembly [34], make sure that the distance is 9.2745 in.
(235.57 mm)±0.0600 in. (1.52 mm).
2) At the inboard push rod assembly [34], make sure that the distance is 9.2319 in.
(234.49 mm)±0.0600 in. (1.52 mm).
(d) If the distance at the inboard or outboard pushrod is not in the limit, then adjust the length
of the applicable aft flap push rod assembly [34] (Figure 401):
1) Remove the rig pin from the crankshaft assembly [17].
2) Use the crankshaft assembly [17] to manually extend the aft flap [2] to the extended
position.
3) Adjust the length of the applicable aft flap push rod assembly [34]:
NOTE: For each 90 degree turn of the aft flap push rod assembly [34], the trailing
edge of the aft flap will move 0.04 in. (1.02 mm).
a) Loosen the nuts [81] on the aft flap push rod assembly [34].
b) Adjust the length of the aft flap push rod assembly [34].
c) Tighten the nuts [81].
d) Install lockwire on the nuts [81] and the locking keys [74].
4) Use the crankshaft assembly [17] to manually retract the aft flap [2] to the retracted
position.
EFFECTIVITY
 ALL
5) Install the rig pin from the rigging pin kit, SPL-1585 in the crankshaft assembly [17].
NOTE: Use rig pin F70207–113 or F70207–114.
6) Make sure that the distance from the trailing edge of the aft flap [2] to the trailing
edge of the upper cove panel [101] is in the limit.
(e) Remove the rig pin from the crankshaft assembly [17].
(f) Use the crankshaft assembly [17] to manually extend the aft flap [2] to the extended
position.
SUBTASK 27-51-14-420-007
(9) Install the aft flap drive rod assembly [43]:
(a) Put the aft flap drive rod assembly [43] in its position between the drive rod fitting [44] and
the crankshaft assembly [17].
(b) Install the bolts [45], washers [46], bushings [47], washers [48] and nuts [49] that attach
the aft flap drive rod assembly [43] to the crankshaft assembly [17] and the drive rod
fitting [44].
1) Make sure that the heads of the bolts [45] are on the inboard side.
(c) Tighten the nuts [49] to 30 in-lb (3.4 N·m)-50 in-lb (5.6 N·m).
(d) Install the pins [50] through the nuts [49].
G. Put the Airplane Back to Its Usual Condition
SUBTASK 27-51-14-410-001
(1) Install the leading edge panel [40] on the outboard end of the main flap [1]:
(a) Apply sealant, A00247 to the mating surface of the leading edge panel [40] and the main
flap [1].
(b) Put the leading edge panel [40] in its position.
(c) Install the bolts [42]:
1) Apply compound, C00528 to the forward and aft rows of holes in the leading edge
panel [40].
2) Install the bolts [42] in the forward and aft rows of holes.
3) Apply sealant, A00247 to the bolts [42] that go in the ribs and stiffeners in the main
flap [1].
4) Install the bolts [42] in the ribs and stiffeners.
SUBTASK 27-51-14-410-002
(2) Install the upper skin panel [4] on the outboard end of the main flap [1]:
(a) Apply sealant, A00247 to the mating surface of the upper skin panel [4] and the main
flap [1].
(b) Put the upper skin panel [4] in its position.
(c) Install the bolts [3]:
1) Apply compound, C00528 to the forward and aft rows of holes in the upper skin
panel [4].
2) Install the bolts [3] in the forward and aft rows of holes.
3) Apply sealant, A00247 to the bolts [3] that go in the ribs and stiffeners in the main
flap [1].
4) Install the bolts [3] in the ribs and stiffeners.
EFFECTIVITY
 ALL
SUBTASK 27-51-14-410-003
(3) Install the lower skin panel [58] on the inboard end of the main flap [1]:
(a) Apply sealant, A00247 to the mating surface of the lower skin panel [58] and the main
flap [1].
(b) Put the lower skin panel [58] in its position.
(c) Install the bolts [57]:
1) Apply compound, C00528 to the forward and aft rows of holes in the lower skin
panel [58].
2) Install the bolts [57] in the forward and aft rows of holes.
3) Apply sealant, A00247 to the bolts [57] that go in the ribs and stiffeners in the main
flap [1].
4) Install the bolts [57] in the ribs and stiffeners.
SUBTASK 27-51-14-410-004
(4) Do this task: Inboard Flap Support Aft Fairing Installation, TASK 27-51-18-400-802.

F. Inboard Flap Outboard Track Removal
SUBTASK 27-51-15-480-002
(1) If you will use the adapter, SPL-1733, install it on the flap track [1]:
(a) Install the adapter, SPL-1733, on the flap track [1] approximately 35 in. (89 cm) aft of the
track attach fitting.
(b) Put a low profile hydraulic jack, COM-1568, below the adapter, SPL-1733, to support the
flap track [1].
SUBTASK 27-51-15-000-001
(2) Remove the nut [28], washers [29], and bolt [30] that attach the bonding jumper [27] to the
structure.
SUBTASK 27-51-15-000-002
(3) Remove the clamp [34] that attaches the electrical wire to the bracket as follows:
(a) Remove the bolt [31], washer [32], and clipnut [33].
SUBTASK 27-51-15-020-004
(4) Disconnect the forward end of the flap track [1] from the track attach fitting.
(a) Remove the bolts [13] and washers [12] that attach the failsafe fitting assembly [14] to the
track attach fitting.
(b) Remove the pin [18], nut [17], washer [16], and fuse pin [15] from the forward end of the
flap track [1].
SUBTASK 27-51-15-020-005
(5) Disconnect the aft end of the flap track [1] from the structure.
(a) Remove the bolt [8], washer [9], washer [10], and nut [11] from the outboard side of the
flap track [1].
(b) Remove the bolt [7], washer [6], washer [4], and nut [3] from the inboard side of the flap
track [1].
(c) Measure the thickness of the shim [5].
1) Make sure to mark the track with this measurement data.
NOTE: This measurement data for the removal and replacement of the flap tracks
is an important step to obtain ample free movement in the fuse pin joint at
the forward end of the flap track and return of the flaps to former operating
condition.
EFFECTIVITY
 ALL
SUBTASK 27-51-15-020-006
(6) If you will install a new flap track [1], remove the transmission attach fitting [2] from the flap
track [1].
(a) Remove the pin [25], nut [24], washer [26], and bolt [19] that attach the forward end of the
transmission attach fitting [2].
(b) Remove the pin [23], nut [22], washer [21], and bolt [20] that attach the aft end of the
transmission attach fitting [2].

G. Inboard Flap Outboard Track Installation
SUBTASK 27-51-15-420-001
(1) If it is not installed, install the transmission attach fitting [2].
(a) Put the transmission attach fitting [2] in its position on the flap track [1].
(b) Install the bolt [20], washer [21], and nut [22] that attach the aft end of the transmission
attach fitting [2] to the flap track [1].
(c) Install the pin [23] in the nut [22].
(d) Install the bolt [19], washer [26], and nut [24] that attach the forward end of the
transmission attach fitting [2] to the flap track [1].
(e) Install the pin [25] in the nut [24].
SUBTASK 27-51-15-480-003
(2) If you will use the adapter, SPL-1733, install it on the flap track [1].
(a) Install the adapter, SPL-1733, on the flap track [1] approximately 35 in. (89 cm) aft of the
track attach fitting.
(b) Put a low profile hydraulic jack, COM-1568, below the adapter, SPL-1733, to support the
flap track [1].
EFFECTIVITY
 ALL
SUBTASK 27-51-15-420-002
(3) Install the flap track [1].
(a) If it is not installed, install the shim [5] on the structure.
1) Make sure the shim [5] is the same thickness as the shim [5] that you removed.
NOTE: The original thickness of the shim [5] is on a marker on the structure.
NOTE: If it is necessary to replace the flap track with a new unit, a new shim [5]
may need to be made and should be marked and checked after the nuts
are torqued that attach the flap track to the structure.
2) Apply sealant, A00247, to the mating surface between the shim [5] and flap
track [1], and mating surface between the shim [5] and structure.
3) Put the shim [5] in its position.
(b) Attach the aft end of the flap track [1].
1) Lift the flap track [1] to its location on the structure.
2) Install the bolt [7], washer [6], washer [4], and nut [3] that attach the inboard end of
the flap track [1].
3) Install the bolt [8], washer [9], washer [10], and nut [11] that attach the outboard end
of the flap track [1].
(c) Attach the forward end of the flap track [1].
1) Apply grease, D00633, to the outside of the fuse pin [15] and the inside of the
bushings.
2) Install the fuse pin [15] to attach the forward end of the flap track [1] to the track
attach fitting.
(d) Make sure that you can turn the fuse pin [15] in the joint with a maximum of 10 in-lb
(1 N·m).
NOTE: You can push up on the forward end of the flap track to take the weight off the
fuse pin when you measure the torque.
(e) Install the washer [16] and nut [17] on the fuse pin [15].
(f) Tighten the nut [17] to 330 in-lb (37 N·m) - 350 in-lb (40 N·m).
(g) Loosen the nut [17] to align the hole for the pin [18].
(h) Install the pin [18] in the nut [17].
(i) Apply the fillet seal with sealant, A00247, around the joint where the shim [5], flap
track [1], and airplane structure is attached.
SUBTASK 27-51-15-420-003
(4) Install the failsafe fitting assembly [14] on the track attach fitting.
(a) Put the failsafe fitting assembly [14] in its location on the track attach fitting.
(b) Install the bolts [13] and washers [12] to attach the failsafe fitting assembly [14].
SUBTASK 27-51-15-400-002
(5) Install the clamp [34] that attaches the electrical wire to the bracket as follows:
(a) Install the bolt [31], washer [32], and clipnut [33] that attach the clamp [34] and electrical
wire to the bracket.
SUBTASK 27-51-15-400-001
(6) Install the bonding jumper [27] as follows:
EFFECTIVITY
 ALL
(a) Use cotton wiper, G00034, moist in alcohol, B00130, to clean the mating surfaces of the
washers [29] and bonding jumper [27].
(b) Clean the mating surface of the structure with 60 grit or finer wet/dry aluminum oxide
sandpaper, G51464.
1) Clean the mating surface of the structure with wiper, G50262, moist in alcohol,
B00130.
2) If it is necessary, use wiper, G50262, to remove remaining solvent.
(c) Apply sealant, A00247, to the under-head surface of the bolt [30].
(d) Install the bolt [30], washers [29], and nut [28] that attach the bonding jumper [27] to the
structure.
1) Tighten the nut [28] to 28 in-lb (3.2 N·m) - 35 in-lb (4.0 N·m).
2) Make sure that the squeeze-out of sealant, A00247, between the bolt [30] and
structure is continuous.
3) Make sure that the squeeze-out of sealant, A00247, is not more than 0.20 in.
(5.1 mm) in all directions.
a) If it is necessary, use cotton wiper, G00034, moist in solvent, B00184, to
remove excess of sealant, A00247.
(e) Measure the electrical bonding resistance between the bonding jumper [27] and airplane
structure (SWPM 20-20-00).
1) Use the non-intrinsically safe bonding meter, COM-614.
2) Make sure that the electrical bonding resistance is 0.001 ohm (1.0 milliohm) or less.

SUBTASK 27-51-15-480-008
(7) Do the following steps to install the trailing edge inboard flap hold equipment, SPL-9469:
NOTE: The inboard flap hold equipment, SPL-9469 will support the inboard flap so that
inboard flap removal is not necessary.
NOTE: It is not necessary that the aft flap be installed in order to install the inboard flap hold
equipment, SPL-9469.
(a) Inflate the shock strut with a sufficient amount of nitrogen, G00018 to provide clearance
for the mounting bracket of the lower brace assembly from hold equipment, SPL-9469
(Main Landing Gear Shock Strut Servicing, Airplane on the Ground,
TASK 12-15-31-610-802).
(b) Attach the lower brace assembly to the bottom of the outer cylinder of the main landing
gear.
(c) Adjust the length of the lower brace assembly until you can attach the lower brace
assembly to the aft flap track assembly.
(d) Attach the upper brace assembly to the upper end of the outer cylinder.
(e) Adjust the length of the upper brace assembly until you can attach the upper brace
assembly to the aft most fitting on the lower brace assembly.
(f) Attach the side brace assembly to the side brace of the main landing gear.
NOTE: The flange of the backing plate is oriented in the downward direction.
(g) Adjust the length of the side brace assembly until you can attach it to the forward most
fitting on the lower brace assembly.
(h) Extend the three brace assemblies until the weight of the flap is supported.
1) If necessary, push up on the inboard flap while extending the brace assemblies.

G. Inboard Flap Inboard Track Installation
SUBTASK 27-51-15-420-007
(1) If they are not installed, install the transmission attach fitting [53] and link assembly [45] on the
flap track assemblies [41]:
(a) Install the transmission attach fitting [53]:
1) Put the transmission attach fitting [53] in its position on the flap track
assemblies [41].
CAUTION
MAKE SURE THAT THE HEAD OF THE OUTBOARD BOLT POINTS
TO OUTBOARD OF THE TRANSMISSION ATTACH FITTING. THE
NUT AND COTTER PIN CAN TOUCH THE FLAP-SKEW-CONTROL
ROD AND CAUSE DAMAGE. IF YOU DO NOT OBEY, DAMAGE TO
THE FLAP-SKEW-CONTROL ROD CAN OCCUR.
2) Install the bolts [60], bolt [64], washers [61] and nuts [62] that attach the
transmission attach fitting [53] to the flap track assemblies [41].
3) Tighten the nuts [62] to 600 in-lb (67.8 N·m)-800 in-lb (90.4 N·m).
4) Install the pins [63] in the nuts [62].
(b) Install the link assembly [45] on the flap track assemblies [41]:
1) Put the link assembly [45] in its position on the flap track assemblies [41].
2) Install the bolt [72], washer [69], washer [70] and nut [71] to attach the link
assembly [45] to the flap track assemblies [41].
NOTE: The track assembly [41] comes with a bonded washer already installed.
After installing washer [69], there should be two washers, not just one.
3) Tighten the nut [71] to 290 in-lb (32.8 N·m) - 510 in-lb (57.6 N·m).
4) Install lockwire between the nut [71] and the washer [70].
5) Install the bolt [68], washer [65] and nut [67] in the bolt [72].
6) Tighten the nut [67] to 30 in-lb (3.4 N·m) - 60 in-lb (6.8 N·m).
7) Install the pin [66] in the nut [67].
SUBTASK 27-51-15-480-006
(2) If you will use the adapter, SPL-1733, install it on the flap track assemblies [41]:
(a) Install the adapter, SPL-1733 on the flap track assemblies [41] approximately 20 inches
(50 cm) aft of the track forward attach fitting.
(b) Put a low profile hydraulic jack, COM-1568 below the adapter, SPL-1733 to support the
flap track assemblies [41].
SUBTASK 27-51-15-420-008
(3) Connect the forward end of the flap track assemblies [41]:
(a) Put the flap track assemblies [41] in its position on the forward attach assembly [50].
(b) Install the bolt [51], washer [54] and nut [58] that attach the flap track assemblies [41] to
the forward attach assembly [50].
(c) Install the pin [59] in the nut [58].
(d) Install the bolt [52], washer [55] and nut [56] that attach the flap track assemblies [41] to
the forward attach assembly [50].
(e) Install the pin [57] in the nut [56].

 ALL

(4) Connect the link assembly [45] to the structure:
(a) Put the link assembly [45] in its position on the structure.
(b) Install the bolt [49], washer [47] and nut [48] to attach the link assembly [45] to the
structure.
(c) Tighten the nut [48] to 290-510 pound-inches (32.8-57.6 newton-meters).
(d) Install lockwire between the nut [48] and the washer [47].
(e) Install the bolt [46], washer [42] and nut [43] in the bolt [49].
(f) Tighten the nut [43] to 30-60 pound-inches (3.4-6.7 newton-meters).
(g) Install the pin [44] in the nut [43].

SUBTASK 27-51-16-420-001
(1) If the downstop is not installed on the aft flap track [2], do these steps:
(a) Install the bolt [11], bushings [9], washer [10], washer [7] and nut [8] on the aft flap
track [2].

SUBTASK 27-51-16-420-002

flap [1].

cartridge assemblies [5] and the aft flap track support [6].

flap track support [6].

the aft flap track support [6].
SUBTASK 27-51-16-420-003
(3) Do this task: Inboard Aft Flap Installation, TASK 27-51-12-400-801.

SUBTASK 27-51-18-420-001
(1) If it is not installed, install the fairing attach fitting [13] on the transmission attach fitting [10].
(a) Apply primer, C00259, to the mating surfaces of the shim [7].

fitting [10].

SUBTASK 27-51-18-420-002

studs.

to the holes for the bolts [3] and bolts [5].

attach fitting [13].
1) Tighten the bolts [3] to 90 in-lb (10 N·m) - 125 in-lb (14 N·m).
(f) Install the bolts [5] to attach the forward end of the forward fairing assembly [1].
1) Tighten the bolts [5] to 80 in-lb (9.04 N·m).

bushing [46].

assembly [42]:

H. Inboard Flap Outboard Aft Fairing Adjustment
SUBTASK 27-51-18-220-001
(1) Measure the clearance between the top surface of the aft fairing assembly [3] and the inboard
flap [1].
NOTE: Measure the clearance at the aft edge of the inboard flap [1] on the inboard and
outboard sides of the aft fairing assembly [3].
(a) Make sure the clearance is in the limit of 0.2884 ±0.050 inch (7.325 ±1.27 millimeters).
NOTE: The aft seal [5] should be compressed 20 to 40 percent.
(b) Make sure the clearance is approximately the same on the inboard and outboard sides of
the aft fairing assembly [3].
SUBTASK 27-51-18-820-003
(2) If the clearance is not in the limit, or if it is not the same on the inboard and outboard sides,
adjust the position of the aft fairing assembly [3]:
 006, 007, 013, 014, 018-020, 043, 044, 056-063, 067-078, 081, 083-103, 111-114, 121-129, 131,
132, 135, 138-168
(a) Remove the bolts [6] that attach the tailcone assembly [4] to the aft fairing assembly [3].
 169, 174-179, 182-187, 189-203, 205-209, 212-220, 223, 224, 231-236, 239-298, 301-304, 306,
308, 315-317, 322-341, 343, 346-999
(b) Remove the bolts [6] and bolts [29] that attach the tailcone assembly [4] to the aft fairing
assembly [3].
 ALL
(c) Remove the tailcone assembly [4] from the aft fairing assembly [3].
(d) If the clearance is not the same on the inboard and outboard sides, adjust the length of
the adjust rod [11]:
1) Loosen the locknuts [10] on the adjust rod [11].
2) Adjust the length of the adjust rod [11] until the clearance is the same on the
inboard and outboard sides of the aft fairing assembly [3].
3) Tighten the locknuts [10] on the adjust rod [11].
4) Install lockwire on the locknuts [10].
(e) If the clearance is not in the limit, adjust the length of the drive rod [8]:
1) Loosen the locknuts [7] on the drive rod [8].
2) Adjust the length of the drive rod [8] until the clearance is in the limit.
3) Tighten the locknuts [7] on the drive rod [8].
4) Install lockwire on the locknuts [7].
(f) Make sure the clearance is in the limit and it is the same on the inboard and outboard
sides of the aft fairing assembly [3].
SUBTASK 27-51-18-220-002
(3) Make sure that the seals [18] on the sides of the aft fairing assembly [3] are compressed
evenly against the lower surface of the inboard flap [1].
(a) Make sure that the clearance is 0.30 in. (7.6 mm) - 0.60 in. (15.24 mm) between the aft
fairing assembly [3] side and the lower surface of the inboard flap [1] and wing.
EFFECTIVITY
 ALL
SUBTASK 27-51-18-820-004
(4) If the seals [18] are not compressed evenly against the lower surface of the inboard flap [1],
adjust the position of the seals [18]:
(a) Remove the nut [16], washer [15], washer [13], bolt [12] and bushing [14] that attach the
drive rod [8] to the inboard flap [1].
(b) Lower the aft end of the aft fairing assembly [3] to get access to the fasteners for the
seals [18].
(c) Loosen the nuts [19] on the retainer [20].
(d) Move the seal [18] and the retainer [20].
NOTE: Make sure you move the seal [18] and the retainer [20] together as a unit.
(e) Tighten the nuts [19] that hold the retainer [20].
(f) Lift the aft end of the aft fairing assembly [3] to align the drive rod [8] with the inboard
flap [1].
(g) Install the bushing [14], bolt [12], washer [13], washer [15] and nut [16].
(h) Install the pin [17] in the nut [16].
I. Inboard Flap Outboard Forward Fairing Adjustment
SUBTASK 27-51-18-220-003
(1) Measure the mismatch between the forward fairing assembly [2] and the aft fairing
assembly [3].
NOTE: Measure the mismatch on the inboard side and on the bottom of the forward fairing
assembly [2].
(a) Make sure the mismatch is in the limit of +0.03 to -0.01 inch (+0.76 to -0.25 millimeter).
NOTE: A positive (+) mismatch is when the forward fairing assembly [2] extends past the
aft fairing assembly [3]. A negative (-) mismatch is when the aft fairing
assembly [3] extends past the forward fairing assembly [2].
SUBTASK 27-51-18-220-004
(2) Make sure the seals [26] on the sides of the forward fairing assembly [2] are compressed
evenly against the lower surface of the wing.
SUBTASK 27-51-18-020-006
(3) If the mismatch is not in the limit or if the seals [26] are not compressed evenly, do this task:
Inboard Flap Support Forward Fairing Removal, TASK 27-51-18-000-801.
SUBTASK 27-51-18-820-005
(4) If the mismatch between the forward fairing assembly [2] and the aft fairing assembly [3] is not
in the limit, then adjust the position of the forward fairing assembly [2]:
(a) If the mismatch is not in the limit on the inboard side of the forward fairing assembly [2],
adjust the position of the fairing attach fitting [24]:
1) Loosen the bolts [23] that attach the fairing attach fitting [24] to the transmission
attach fitting [21].
2) Move the fairing attach fitting [24] inboard or outboard to get the mismatch in the
limit.
3) Tighten the bolts [23].
(b) If the mismatch is not in the limit on the bottom of the forward fairing assembly [2],
change the thickness of the shims [25].
EFFECTIVITY
 ALL
1) Apply primer, C00259 to the mating surfaces of the shims [25] and the fairing attach
fitting [24].
SUBTASK 27-51-18-820-006
(5) If the seals [26] are not compressed evenly against the lower surface of the wing, adjust the
position of the seals [26]:
(a) Loosen the nuts [27] on the retainer [28].
(b) Move the seal [26] and the retainer [28].
NOTE: Make sure you move the seal [26] and the retainer [28] together as a unit.
(c) Tighten the nuts [27] that hold the retainer [28].
SUBTASK 27-51-18-420-004
(6) If you removed the forward fairing assembly [2], do this task: Inboard Flap Support Forward
Fairing Installation, TASK 27-51-18-400-801.

F. Outboard Trailing Edge Flap Removal
SUBTASK 27-51-21-020-010
(1) Manually retract trailing edge flap enough to get access to the bolt [43] and bolt [33A]
(TASK 27-51-00-980-801).
NOTE: During the manual operation of the trailing edge flap it is not necessary to do trailing
edge flap system reactivation.
SUBTASK 27-51-21-020-009
(2) On the inboard track [53], remove the bolt [43], nut [45], and washers [44] under the bolt [43]
(View H, Figure 401).
NOTE: The roller can block access to the bolt and therefore it is recommended to remove this
bolt before extending flaps to the stops on the jackscrews.
SUBTASK 27-51-21-020-008
(3) On the outboard track [41], remove the bolt [33A], washers [34] and nut [35] under the
bolt [33A] (View F, Figure 401).
NOTE: The roller can block access to the bolt and therefore it is recommended to remove this
bolt before extending flaps to the stops on the jackscrews.
SUBTASK 27-51-21-020-011
(4) Extend the tailing edge flap to the stops on the jackscrews (TASK 27-51-00-980-801).
SUBTASK 27-51-21-020-001
(5) Disconnect the skew control rod [3] from the inboard and outboard carriage [13]:
(a) Remove the nut [18], washer [17], bushing [16], washer [15], and bolt [14] that attach the
skew control rod [3] to the carriage [13].
(b) Move the skew control rod [3] away from the carriage [13].
SUBTASK 27-51-21-020-002
(6) Disconnect the aft flap drive rods [11] from the inboard and outboard drive rod attach
fittings [10]:
(a) Remove the nut [8], washer [7], washer [5], bolt [4], and bushing [6] that attach the aft
flap drive rod [11] to the drive rod attach fitting [10].
NOTE: The aft flap will move down approximately 2 in. (51 mm) when you remove the
bolt.
(b) Move the aft flap drive rods [11] away from the drive rod attach fittings [10].
SUBTASK 27-51-21-010-004
(7) Remove the leading edge skin panel [55] from the main flap assembly [1] forward of the
inboard carriage [13]:
(a) These are the panels:
Number Name/Location
567BT Flap, Forward Carriage Bearing And Fitting
667BT Flap, Forward Carriage Bearing And Fitting
(b) Remove the bolts [56] that attach the leading edge skin panel [55].
(c) Remove the leading edge skin panel [55] from the main flap assembly [1].
SUBTASK 27-51-21-480-001
(8) Install the sling equipment, SPL-1729, on the main flap assembly [1] (Figure 402):
EFFECTIVITY
 ALL
(a) Remove the bolts [74] at the inboard end and outboard ends of the main flap
assembly [1].
NOTE: The bolts are located along the rear spar, above the inboard and outboard
carriages.
(b) Remove the bolts [75] at the front spar on the main flap assembly [1].
(c) Install the sling fittings [71] in the location of the bolts [74] and bolts [75].
(d) Connect the sling equipment, SPL-1729, to the 30 foot height (2000 lb capacity) lift crane,
STD-1095.
(e) Use the sling equipment, SPL-1729, to hold the weight of the outboard flap.
SUBTASK 27-51-21-020-003

roller stop [32], roller stop [42], and fairing attach fitting [36] to the outboard
track [41].
2) Remove the roller stop [32] and roller stop [42] from the outboard track [41].
3) Remove the nuts [35], washers [34] under the bolts [33] that attach the fairing attach
fitting [36] to the outboard track [41].
4) Remove the fairing attach fitting [36] from the outboard track [41].
(b) On the inboard track [53], remove the roller stop [46], roller stop [54], and fairing attach
fitting [51]:

roller stop [46], roller stop [54], and fairing attach fitting [51] to the inboard track [53].

attach fitting [51] to the inboard track [53].
4) Remove the fairing attach fitting [51] from the inboard track [53].
SUBTASK 27-51-21-020-004
(10) Remove the main flap assembly [1]:

disconnected from the carriages [13].
2) Remove the nuts [24], washers [23], and bolts [22] from the carriages [13].
3) Remove the inboard carriage bushings [27] and the outboard carriage bushings [21]
from the gimbals [20] and the carriages [13].
(c) Move the gimbals [20] away from the carriages [13].

 ALL

STD-1095, to move the main flap assembly [1] aft and down away from the tracks.

SUBTASK 27-51-21-220-005
(1) If you will install a different flap than the one you removed, do a check of the thickness of the
shims [95] on the inboard carriage [101] and outboard carriage [96].
NOTE: There is no mismatch, or alignment dimension to fixed structure that the flap is
adjusted to meet. The flap shims can be changed from the nominal dimension to meet
lateral trim tolerances.
(a) Make sure that thickness of the shims [95] is the same as it was on the previous flap.
EFFECTIVITY
 ALL
1) If you do not know the original thickness of the shims [95], change the thickness to
the nominal dimension.
NOTE: The nominal thickness of the shims is 0.25 in. (6.35 mm). The maximum
thickness of the shims is 0.50 in. (12.70 mm). The minimum thickness of
the shims is 0.00 inch.
SUBTASK 27-51-21-820-006

the inboard carriage [101] and outboard carriage [96].

to the outboard carriage [96].

to get the correct shim thickness.
3) Apply sealant, A00247, to the mating surfaces of the shims [95].
4) Put the shims [95] in their location between the aft link fitting [91] and outboard
carriage [96].
NOTE: The nominal thickness of the shims is 0.25 in. (6.35 mm). The maximum
thickness of the shims is 0.50 in. (12.70 mm). The minimum thickness of
the shims is 0.00 inch.

H. Outboard Trailing Edge Flap Installation
SUBTASK 27-51-21-420-001
(1) Install the main flap assembly [1] (Figure 401):
CAUTION
BE VERY CAREFUL WHEN YOU LIFT THE OUTBOARD FLAP FROM THE
GROUND. YOU CAN CAUSE DAMAGE TO THE TRAILING EDGE OF THE
FLAP.
(a) Use the sling equipment, SPL-1729, and the 30 foot height (2000 lb capacity) lift crane,
STD-1095, to move the main flap assembly [1] up into its position aft of the main tracks.
(b) If the aft flap [2] is installed, make sure that it is in the extended position.
(c) Engage the rollers on the carriages [13] with the outboard track [41] and inboard
track [53].
NOTE: Engage the rollers for the outboard carriage with the flap outboard track first. The
installation is easier if the rollers for the outboard carriage start to engage the flap
outboard track before the rollers for the inboard carriage.
(d) Use the sling equipment, SPL-1729, to move the main flap assembly [1] up and forward
on the flap tracks until the carriages [13] align with the gimbals [20].
(e) Connect the carriages [13] to the gimbals [20]:
1) Remove the support from the ballscrew [19] and move the gimbal [20] to its position
in the carriage [13].
2) On the left wing, make sure that the ball returns [25] on the ballscrew nuts [26] are
outboard.
3) On the right wing, make sure that the ball returns [25] on the ballscrew nut [26] are
inboard.
NOTE: The specified orientation is preferred but both orientations are acceptable.
 006, 007, 013, 014

CARRIAGE CAN BREAK. IF YOU DO NOT OBEY, INJURY TO
PERSONNEL AND DAMAGE TO EQUIPMENT CAN OCCUR.

grease into the bushings. If more pressure is necessary, wear safety glasses. Do
not use more than 2500 psi (17,237 kPa).

G. Outboard Trailing Edge Flap Adjustment
NOTE: There is no mismatch, or alignment dimension to fixed structure that the flap is adjusted to
meet. The flap shims can be changed from the nominal to meet lateral trim tolerances.
SUBTASK 27-51-21-220-006
(1) If you installed a different flap, then adjust the thickness of the shims [65] to the same
thickness as the original flap.
NOTE: The thickness of the shims [65] on the original flap may have been adjusted for lateral
trim per (TASK 27-09-71-820-801).
(a) If you do not know the original thickness of the shims [65], then change the thickness to
the nominal dimension.
NOTE: The nominal thickness of the shims [65] is 0.25 in. (6.35 mm).
SUBTASK 27-51-21-210-001
(2) On the inboard and outboard carriage [43], make sure three of the four main track rollers [44]
touch the flap track [45] (Figure 502).
NOTE: If you cannot get three of the four main track roller [44] to touch, it is permitted for the
two forward rollers, or the two aft rollers to touch.
SUBTASK 27-51-21-820-002
(3) If it is necessary, then adjust the position of the main flap assembly [6] (Figure 503):
NOTE: To adjust the position of the main flap assembly [6], you will change the thickness of
the shims [65] at the aft link fitting [61] and aft link fitting [67] on the inboard and
outboard carriages.
EFFECTIVITY
 ALL
(a) Do this task: Trailing Edge Flap System Reactivation, TASK 27-51-00-440-801.
(b) Extend the trailing edge flaps to the 40-unit position (TASK 27-51-00-860-803).
(c) Do this task: Trailing Edge Flap System Deactivation, TASK 27-51-00-040-801.

1) Remove the nuts [64], washers [63] and bolts [62] that attach the aft link fitting [61]
to the outboard carriage [66].
2) Add or remove shims [65] between the aft link fitting [61] and the outboard
carriage [66] to get the correct shim thickness.
3) Apply sealant, A00247 to the mating surfaces of the shims [65].
4) Put the shims [65] in their location between the aft link fitting [61] and the outboard
carriage [66].
NOTE: The nominal thickness of the shims [65] is 0.25 in. (6.35 mm). The
maximum thickness of the shims [65] is 0.50 in. (12.70 mm). The minimum
thickness of the shims [65] is 0.00 in. (0.00 mm).

outboard edge of the rollers [8].
(h) Retract the trailing edge flaps, do these steps:

3) Do this task: Trailing Edge Flap System Deactivation, TASK 27-51-00-040-801.

 ALL
(i) If the distance is not in the limit of 0.00 in. (0.00 mm) to 0.06 in. (1.52 mm), then adjust

NOTE: The rollers [8] must not be over the edge of the deflection control track [5].
1) Remove the bolts [3] and washers [4] that attach the deflection control roller
assembly [2] to the rib [1].
2) Remove the nuts [12], bushings [11], bushings [9] and rollers [8] from the deflection
control roller assembly [2].
3) Change the position of the bushings [9] or bushings [11] to adjust the position of the
rollers [8].
4) Install the rollers [8], bushings [9], bushings [11] and nuts [12] on the deflection
control roller assembly [2].
5) Tighten the nuts [12] to 300 in-lb (34 N·m) - 410 in-lb (46 N·m).
6) Put the deflection control roller assembly [2] in its location on the rib [1].
7) Apply compound, C00528 to the holes in the rib [1] for the bolts [3].
8) Loosely install the bolts [3] and washers [4] that attach the deflection control roller
assembly [2] to the rib [1].
9) Move the deflection control roller assembly [2] until the upper roller [8] touches the
upper surface of the deflection control track [5].
10) Tighten the bolts [3] to 55 in-lb (6 N·m) - 90 in-lb (10 N·m).
(j) Extend the trailing edge flaps, do these steps:
1) Do this task: Trailing Edge Flap System Reactivation, TASK 27-51-00-440-801.
2) Extend the trailing edge flaps to the 40-unit position (TASK 27-51-00-860-803).
3) Do this task: Trailing Edge Flap System Deactivation, TASK 27-51-00-040-801.

the deflection control roller assembly [2].
(l) Retract the trailing edge flaps, do these steps:
1) Do this task: Trailing Edge Flap System Reactivation, TASK 27-51-00-440-801.
2) Retract the trailing edge flaps to the retracted position (TASK 27-51-00-860-804).
3) Do this task: Trailing Edge Flap System Deactivation, TASK 27-51-00-040-801.
(m) If the clearance is not in the limit of 0.1248 ±0.0500 in. (3.17 ±1.27 mm), then adjust the

1) Remove the bolts [3] and washers [4] that attach the deflection control roller
assembly [2] to the rib [1].
2) Remove the nuts [15], washers [14], fillers [7], bolts [13] and rub pad [10] from the
deflection control roller assembly [2].
3) Add or remove fillers [7] to the rub pad [10].
NOTE: For each filler [7] that you remove, install two additional washers [14] under

washers [14] from under the nut [15].
4) Install the bolts [13], fillers [7], rub pad [10], washers [14] and nuts [15] on the
deflection control roller assembly [2].
5) Put the deflection control roller assembly [2] in its location on the rib [1].
6) Apply compound, C00528 to the holes in the rib [1] for the bolts [3].

 ALL

9) Tighten the bolts [3] to 55 in-lb (6 N·m) - 90 in-lb (10 N·m)).

(f) Retract the trailing edge flaps to the retracted position. To retract the flaps, do this task:
Retract the Trailing Edge Flaps, TASK 27-51-00-860-804.
(g) Do this task: Trailing Edge Flap System Deactivation, TASK 27-51-00-040-801.
(h) Make sure the mismatch between the lower surface of the main flap assembly [6] and the
lower fixed panels [41] is in the limits.
SUBTASK 27-51-21-220-003
(10) Make sure the seals [42] on the lower fixed panels [41] are compressed against the leading
edge of the main flap assembly [6] (Figure 502).
SUBTASK 27-51-21-820-005
(11) If the seals [42] are not compressed against the main flap assembly [6], adjust the position of
the seals [42] (Figure 504):
(a) Do this task: Trailing Edge Flap System Reactivation, TASK 27-51-00-440-801.
(b) Extend the trailing edge flaps to the get access to the seals [42]. To extend them, do this
task: Extend the Trailing Edge Flaps, TASK 27-51-00-860-803.
EFFECTIVITY
 ALL
(c) Do this task: Trailing Edge Flap System Deactivation, TASK 27-51-00-040-801.
(d) Loosen the bolts [98] that attach the seals [42] to the lower fixed panel [41].
(e) Adjust the position of the seals [42].
(f) Tighten the bolts [98] that attach the seals [42].
H. Put the Airplane Back to Its Usual Condition
SUBTASK 27-51-21-410-004
(1) Install the aft fairings on the flap supports:
(a) Do this task: Outboard Flap Outboard Support Aft Fairing Installation,
TASK 27-51-28-400-802.
(b) Do this task: Outboard Flap Inboard Support Aft Fairing Installation,
TASK 27-51-28-400-804.
SUBTASK 27-51-21-440-002
(2) Do this task: Trailing Edge Flap System Reactivation, TASK 27-51-00-440-801.
SUBTASK 27-51-21-860-007
(3) Retract the trailing edge flaps to the retracted position. To retract the flaps, do this task: Retract
the Trailing Edge Flaps, TASK 27-51-00-860-804.

E. Outboard Aft Flap Removal
SUBTASK 27-51-22-020-001
WARNING
HOLD THE AFT FLAP ASSEMBLY IN ITS POSITION WHEN YOU
DISCONNECT THE RODS [11]. THE AFT FLAP ASSEMBLY WILL MOVE AFT
WHEN YOU DISCONNECT THE RODS [11]. THIS CAN CAUSE INJURIES TO
PERSONS OR DAMAGE TO EQUIPMENT.
(1) Disconnect the aft flap [2] from the rods [11]:
(a) Hold the aft flap [2] so it cannot move aft when you disconnect the rods [11].
(b) Remove the pins [8], nuts [7], washers [6], washers [4], bolts [3] and bushings [5] that
attach the rods [11] to the aft flap [2].
(c) Move the rods [11] down, away from the aft flap [2].
SUBTASK 27-51-22-010-003
(2) Remove the coverplate [22] for the outboard roller [21]:
(a) Remove the bolts [23] that attach the coverplate [22].
(b) Remove the coverplate [22] from the main flap [1].
SUBTASK 27-51-22-020-002
(3) Remove the aft flap [2]:
NOTE: The aft flap weighs approximately 50 pounds (23 kilograms).
(a) Support the aft flap [2].
(b) Carefully move the aft flap [2] aft, until it stops.
(c) At the outboard aft flap track [13], remove the pin [35], nut [34], washer [33], washer [31],
bolt [30] and bushing [32] that attach the aft flap track [13] to the aft flap [2].
WARNING
SUPPORT THE AFT FLAP ASSEMBLY WHEN THE BOLTS ARE
REMOVED. WHEN THE LAST BOLTS ARE REMOVED, THE AFT FLAP
ASSEMBLY CAN TURN FREELY ON THE ROLLERS. THIS CAN CAUSE
INJURY TO PERSONNEL AND DAMAGE TO THE EQUIPMENT.
(d) At the remaining aft flap tracks [14], remove the pins [41], nuts [40], washers [39],
washers [37], bolts [36] and bushings [38] that attach the aft flap tracks [14] to the aft
flap [2].
(e) Move the aft flap tracks [14] and aft flap track [13] forward, away from the aft flap [2].
EFFECTIVITY
 ALL
(f) Move the trailing edge of the aft flap [2] down, until it is perpendicular to the main flap [1]
and disengage the rollers [21] from the outboard programming track [20] and the inboard
programming track [28].

G. Outboard Aft Flap Installation
SUBTASK 27-51-22-820-001
(1) If you will not install the same aft flap [2] and main flap [1], make sure that the inboard and
outboard rollers [21] are in the nominal position (Figure 401):
(a) Remove the nut [24], washer [25] and washer [15] from the roller [21].
(b) Disengage the locking washer [16] from the locking washer [17].
(c) The outboard roller [21] is in the nominal position when the locking cutout [27] is 81.8
±10.0 degrees from the lower cutout [26] on the cartridge [18].
(d) The inboard roller [21] is in the nominal position when the locking cutout [27] is 83.6
±10.0 degrees from the lower cutout [26] on the cartridge [29].
(e) If the rollers [21] are not in the nominal position, adjust the position of the rollers [21]:
1) Turn eccentric bushing [19] until the roller [21] is in the nominal position.
(f) Engage the locking washer [16] with the locking washer [17].
(g) Install the washer [15], washer [25] and nut [24] on the roller [21].
(h) Tighten the nut [24] to 95 in-lb (10.7 N·m) - 110 in-lb (12.4 N·m).
(i) Bend a minimum of 2 tabs of the washer [25] to hold the nut [24] in its position.
SUBTASK 27-51-22-010-004
(2) If it is installed on the main flap [1], remove the coverplate [22] for the outboard roller [21]:
(a) Remove the bolts [23] that attach the coverplate [22].
(b) Remove the coverplate [22] from the main flap [1].
SUBTASK 27-51-22-420-001
(3) Make sure that the aft flap track [13] and aft flap tracks [14] are installed on the main flap [1]
(TASK 27-51-26-400-801).
SUBTASK 27-51-22-420-002
(4) Install the aft flap [2]:
NOTE: The aft flap can also be installed at the fully retracted and extended positions.
Installation of the aft flap at full extension will require extra protection of the aft flap
trailing edge and adjacent flap fairing tail cones from damage. At full extension the flap
and fairings are very close together.
(a) Hold the aft flap [2] below and approximately perpendicular to the main flap [1].
(b) Engage the inboard roller [21] with the inboard programming track [28].
(c) Engage the outboard roller [21] the outboard programming track [20].
EFFECTIVITY
 ALL
(d) Lift the trailing edge of the aft flap [2] and hold it in its usual position.
(e) Connect the aft flap [2] to the aft flap track [13] and aft flap track [14]:
1) Move the aft flap track [13] and aft flap track [14] to align with the aft flap [2].
2) Apply grease, D00633, to the shank of the bolt [30], bolts [36] and the inside of the
bushing [32] and bushings [38].
NOTE: It is necessary to not get grease, D00633, on the threads of the bolts.
3) Install the bushings [38], bolts [36] and washers [37] that attach the aft flap
track [14] to the aft flap [2].
4) Install the bushing [32], bolt [30] and washer [31] that attach the aft flap track [13] to
the aft flap [2].
5) Carefully clean all of the grease, D00633, from the threads of the bolts [36] and
bolt [30].
6) On the outboard aft flap track [13], install the washer [33] and nut [34] on the
bolt [30].
7) Tighten the nut [34] to 65 in-lb (7.3 N·m) - 100 in-lb (11.3 N·m).
8) Install the pin [35] in the nut [34].
9) On the remaining aft flap track [14], install the washers [39] and nuts [40] on the
bolts [36].
10) Tighten the nuts [40] to 130 in-lb (14.7 N·m) - 200 in-lb (22.6 N·m).
11) Install the pins [41] in the nuts [40].
SUBTASK 27-51-22-420-003
(5) Connect the aft flap [2] to the rods [11]:
WARNING
HOLD THE AFT FLAP ASSEMBLY IN ITS POSITION WHEN YOU
DISCONNECT THE RODS [11]. THE AFT FLAP ASSEMBLY WILL MOVE
AFT WHEN YOU DISCONNECT THE RODS [11]. THIS CAN CAUSE
INJURIES TO PERSONS OR DAMAGE TO EQUIPMENT.
(a) Move the aft flap [2] until it aligns with the rods [11].
(b) Apply grease, D00633, to the shank of the bolts [3] and the inside of the bushings [5].
NOTE: It is necessary do not get grease, D00633, on the threads of the bolts.
(c) Install the bushings [5], bolts [3] and washers [4] to attach the rods [11] to the aft flap [2].
1) Install bushings [5] from the inboard side on the left wing and from the outboard side
on the right wing.
2) Make sure that the heads of the bolts [3] are inboard.
(d) Carefully clean all of the grease, D00633, from the threads of the bolts [3].
(e) Install the nuts [7] and washers [6] on the bolts [3].
(f) Tighten the nuts [7] to 65 in-lb (7.3 N·m) - 100 in-lb (11.3 N·m).
(g) Install the pins [8] in the nuts [7].
H. Outboard Aft Flap Adjustment
SUBTASK 27-51-22-860-003
(1) If the trailing edge flaps are not fully retracted, do this task: Retract the Trailing Edge Flaps,
TASK 27-51-00-860-804.
EFFECTIVITY
 ALL
SUBTASK 27-51-22-480-001
(2) Install the rig pins (rigging pin kit, SPL-1585) in the rig pin holes in the inboard and outboard
bellcranks [12] and the flap carriages [10].
(a) Apply a load on the aft flap [2] assembly in the up direction.
(b) Install the rig pins (rigging pin kit, SPL-1585) in the rig pin holes in the inboard and
outboard bellcranks [12] and the flap carriages [10].
1) If it is necessary, move the aft flap [2] or the cove panel [52] until you can install the
rig pins.
SUBTASK 27-51-22-220-001
(3) Measure the mismatch between the trailing edge of the aft flap [2] and the main flap [1] (View
D and View E, Figure 402).
(a) Apply a load on the aft flap [2] assembly in the up direction.
(b) At the inboard and outboard ends of the aft flap [2] assembly, measure the mismatch
between the trailing edge of the aft flap [2] and the main flap [1].
SUBTASK 27-51-22-820-002
(4) If the mismatch at the inboard and outboard ends of the aft flap [2] is not in the limit of
0.00 ±0.06 in. (0.000 ±1.524 mm), then adjust the length of the applicable rod [11]
(Figure 401):
(a) Apply a load on the aft flap [2] assembly in the up direction.
(b) Loosen the nuts [9] on the rod [11].
(c) If you cannot get access to the nuts [9], extend the aft flap [2]:
CAUTION
DO NOT OPERATE THE TRAILING EDGE FLAPS WITH RIG PINS
INSTALLED. IF YOU DO NOT OBEY, DAMAGE TO EQUIPMENT CAN
OCCUR.
1) Remove the rig pins from the bellcranks [12] and flap carriages [10].
2) Extend the aft flap [2], until you can get access to the nuts [9]
(TASK 27-51-00-860-803).
(d) Turn the applicable rod [11] until the mismatch is in the limit at the inboard and outboard
ends of the aft flap [2].
NOTE: For each 1/4 turn of the rod, the trailing edge of the aft flap assembly will move
approximately 0.04 in. (1.016 mm).
(e) Tighten the nuts [9] on the rod [11].
(f) Install lockwire on the nuts [9].
(g) If you extended the aft flap [2] to get access to the nuts [9], then do these steps:
1) Retract the aft flap [2] until you can install the rig pins in the bellcranks [12] and flap
carriages [10] (TASK 27-51-00-860-804).
2) Install the rig pins in the bellcranks [12] and flap carriages [10].
(h) Make sure that the mismatch at the inboard and outboard ends of the aft flap [2] is in the
limit.
SUBTASK 27-51-22-980-001
(5) Do a visual examination of the area to make sure that the programming rollers [21] touch the
bottom surface of the programming tracks and the aft rollers for the four inner aft flap tracks
touch the top surface of the tracks.
EFFECTIVITY
 ALL
(a) Apply a load on the aft flap [2] assembly in the up direction.
(b) Do a visual examination of the area to make sure that the programming rollers [21] touch
the bottom surface of the programming tracks.
(c) Do a visual examination of the area to make sure that the aft rollers for the four inner aft
flap tracks touch the top surface of the tracks.
NOTE: If access is limited use an inspection mirror, STD-600, or borescope to do the visual
examination.
NOTE: This is the position the rollers will be in with airloads applied to the flap.
SUBTASK 27-51-22-220-002
(6) At the inboard and outboard ends of the aft flap [2], measure the vertical alignment at the
trailing edge (View B-B and View C-C, Figure 402).
(a) Apply a load on the aft flap [2] assembly in the up direction.
(b) Measure the vertical alignment of the trailing edge of the aft flap [2] and the main flap [1].
1) If the vertical alignment of the trailing edge is not in the limit of 0.000 ±0.100 in.
(0.00 ±2.54 mm), then adjust the rollers [21] for the inboard or outboard
programming tracks.
a) If the trailing edge flaps are not fully retracted, do this task: Retract the Trailing
Edge Flaps, TASK 27-51-00-860-804.
SUBTASK 27-51-22-220-003
(7) At the lower cove panels on the main flap [1], measure the mismatch between the aft flap [2]
and the main flap [1] (View B, Figure 402).
(a) Apply a load on the aft flap [2] assembly in the up direction.
(b) At the lower cove panels on the main flap [1], measure the mismatch between the aft
flap [2] and the main flap [1].
1) If the mismatch is not in the limit of 0.000 ±0.060 in. (0.000 ±1.524 mm), then adjust
the rollers [21] for the inboard and outboard programming tracks.
SUBTASK 27-51-22-820-003
(8) If it is necessary, adjust the rollers [21] for the applicable inboard and outboard programming
tracks (Figure 401):
(a) If you cannot get the aft flap [2] vertical alignment and the lower surface mismatch in the
limits, make sure that the vertical alignment is in the limit.
CAUTION
DO NOT OPERATE THE TRAILING EDGE FLAPS WITH RIG PINS
INSTALLED. IF YOU DO NOT OBEY, DAMAGE TO EQUIPMENT CAN
OCCUR.
(b) Remove the rig pins from the bellcranks [12] and flap carriages [10].
(c) Extend the aft flap [2], until you can get access to the rollers [21]
(TASK 27-51-00-860-803).
(d) Remove the nut [24], washer [25] and washer [15] from the roller [21].
(e) Disengage the locking washer [16] from the locking washer [17].
(f) Turn eccentric bushing [19], until the vertical alignment and the lower surface mismatch
are in the limits.
NOTE: If you turn the eccentric bushing 90 degrees, it will move the trailing edge of the
aft flap assembly approximately 0.050 inches (1.27 mm).
EFFECTIVITY
 ALL
(g) Engage the locking washer [16] with locking washer [17].
(h) Install the washer [15], washer [25] and nut [24] on the roller [21].
(i) Tighten the nut [24] to 95 in-lb (10.7 N·m) - 110 in-lb (12.4 N·m).
(j) Bend the tabs of the washer [25] to hold the nut [24] in its position.
(k) Retract the aft flap [2] until you can install the rig pins in the bellcranks [12] and flap
carriages [10] (TASK 27-51-00-860-804).
(l) Install the rig pins in the bellcranks [12] and flap carriages [10].
(m) Make sure that the vertical alignment and the lower surface mismatch are in the limits.
SUBTASK 27-51-22-980-002
(9) If the programming rollers [21] are adjusted per steps above, do a visual examination of the
area again to make sure that the programming rollers [21] touch the bottom surface of the
programming tracks and the aft rollers for the aft flap tracks touch the top surface of the tracks.
(a) Apply a load on the aft flap [2] assembly in the up direction.
(b) Do a visual examination of the area to make sure that the programming rollers [21] touch
the bottom surface of the programming tracks.
(c) Do a visual examination of the area to make sure that the aft rollers for the aft flap tracks
touch the top surface of the tracks.
NOTE: If access is limited use an inspection mirror, STD-600, or borescope to do the visual
examination.
NOTE: This is the position the rollers will be in with airloads applied to the aft flap.
SUBTASK 27-51-22-000-001
CAUTION
DO NOT OPERATE THE TRAILING EDGE FLAPS WITH RIG PINS
INSTALLED. IF YOU DO NOT OBEY, DAMAGE TO EQUIPMENT CAN OCCUR.
(10) Remove the rig pins from the bellcranks [12] and flap carriages [10].
SUBTASK 27-51-22-710-001
(11) Extend the trailing edge flaps (TASK 27-51-00-860-803).
SUBTASK 27-51-22-410-001
(12) Install the coverplate [22] for the outboard roller [21] on the main flap [1]:
(a) Put the coverplate [22] in its position on the main flap [1].
(b) Install the bolts [23] that attach the coverplate [22].
SUBTASK 27-51-22-220-004
(13) Measure the clearance between the main flap [1] and the upper surface of the aft flap [2] (View
C, Figure 402).
(a) Apply a load on the aft flap [2] assembly in the up direction.
(b) Measure the clearance between the cove panel [52] and the upper surface of the aft
flap [2].
(c) Measure the clearance at all of the cove panel supports [51] and at the aft flap roller
fittings [60].
1) If the trailing edge flaps are not fully retracted, do this task: Retract the Trailing Edge
Flaps, TASK 27-51-00-860-804.
EFFECTIVITY
 ALL
SUBTASK 27-51-22-220-007
(14) Make sure that the rub strip [50] and teflon coating on the upper surface of the aft flap [2] are
not damaged (View C, Figure 402).
(a) If the rub strip [50] is damaged or missing, then do this task: Bonded Phenolic or
Stainless Steel Rub Pad Repair (Heat Source Available), TASK 51-51-00-340-802.
(b) If the teflon coating is damaged, then do this task: Apply The Abrasion-Resistant Teflon
Finish, BMS 10-86 Type I, TASK 51-21-81-370-801.
SUBTASK 27-51-22-820-004
(15) If the clearance between the main flap [1] and the aft flap [2] is not in the limit of
0.0100 +0.1000 / -0.0050 in. (0.25 +2.54 / -0.13 mm), then change the thickness of the
shims [58] on the cove panel support [51] or the shims [59] on the aft flap roller fittings [60].
CAUTION
DO NOT OPERATE THE TRAILING EDGE FLAPS WITH RIG PINS
INSTALLED. IF YOU DO NOT OBEY, DAMAGE TO EQUIPMENT CAN
OCCUR.
(a) Remove the rig pins from the bellcranks [12] and flap carriages [10].
(b) Extend the aft flap [2], until you can get access to the fasteners for the shims [58] and
shims [59] (TASK 27-51-00-860-803).
(c) If it is necessary, change the thickness of the shims [58] on the cove panel support [51]:
1) Remove the nuts [57], washers [56] and bolts [55] that attach the cove panel [52] to
the cove panel support [51].
2) Remove the shims [58] from the cove panel support [51] and the cove panel [52].
3) Change the thickness of the shims [58].
NOTE: The maximum permitted thickness of the shim is 0.050 in. (1.27 mm).
4) Apply sealant, A00247, to the mating surfaces of the shim [58].
5) Put the shim [58] in its position between the cove panel support [51] and the cove
panel [52].
6) Install the bolts [55], washers [56] and nuts [57].
(d) If it is necessary, change the thickness of the shims [59] on the aft flap roller fittings [60]:
1) Remove the nuts [63], washers [62] and bolts [61] that attach the cove panel [52] to
the aft flap roller fittings [60].
2) Remove the shims [59] from the aft flap roller fittings [60] and the cove panel [52].
3) Change the thickness of the shims [59].
NOTE: The maximum permitted thickness of the shim is 0.050 in. (1.27 mm).
4) Apply sealant, A00247, to the mating surfaces of the shims [59].
5) Put the shims [59] in their position between the aft flap roller fittings [60] and the
cove panel [52].
6) Install the bolts [61], washers [62] and nuts [63].
7) If it is necessary, trim the excess shims [59] that extends past the aft flap roller
fittings [60].
(e) Retract the aft flap [2] until you can install the rig pins in the bellcranks [12] and flap
carriages [10] (TASK 27-51-00-860-804).
(f) Install the rig pins in the bellcranks [12] and flap carriages [10].
EFFECTIVITY
 ALL
(g) Make sure that the clearance between the main flap [1] and the upper surface of the aft
flap [2] is in the limit.
SUBTASK 27-51-22-220-006
(16) Measure the deflection of the upper cove panel [52] of the main flap [1] at the inboard and
outboard ends of the aft flap [2] (View D-D, Figure 402):
(a) Apply a load on the aft flap [2] assembly in the up direction.
NOTE: The aft flap assembly can push up on the upper cove panel and cause the panel
to deflect.
(b) Measure the deflection of the upper cove panel [52] of the main flap [1] at the inboard
and outboard ends of the aft flap [2].
1) Make sure that the deflection is a maximum of 0.200 in. (5.08 mm).
SUBTASK 27-51-22-220-005
(17) Make sure that the seals on the aft lower surface of the main flap [1] are in the correct position:
(a) Apply a load on the aft flap [2] assembly in the up direction.
(b) Measure the distance between the aft edge of the seal [54] and the seam on the lower
surface of the aft flap [2] (View A-A, Figure 402).
NOTE: This distance is called DIMENSION Y.
(c) At the inboard end of the aft flap [2], make sure that DIMENSION Y is 5.76 ±0.10 in.
(146.30 ±2.54 mm).
(d) At the inboard side of the inboard flap support, make sure that DIMENSION Y is
5.57 ±0.10 in. (141.48 ±2.54 mm).
(e) At the outboard side of the inboard flap support, make sure that DIMENSION Y is
5.46 ±0.10 in. (138.68 ±2.54 mm).
(f) At the inboard side of the outboard flap support, make sure that DIMENSION Y is
4.61 ±0.10 in. (117.09 ±2.54 mm).
(g) At the outboard side of the outboard flap support, make sure that DIMENSION Y is
4.46 ±0.10 in. (113.28 ±2.54 mm).
(h) At the outboard end of the aft flap [2], make sure that DIMENSION Y is 4.06 ±0.10 in.
(103.12 ±2.54 mm).
SUBTASK 27-51-22-820-005
(18) If the position of the seals [54] are not in the limits, adjust the position of the seals [54]:
CAUTION
DO NOT OPERATE THE TRAILING EDGE FLAPS WITH RIG PINS
INSTALLED. IF YOU DO NOT OBEY, DAMAGE TO EQUIPMENT CAN
OCCUR.
(a) Remove the rig pins from the bellcranks [12] and flap carriages [10].
(b) Extend the aft flap [2], until you can get access to the fasteners for the seals [54]
(TASK 27-51-00-860-803).
(c) Adjust the position of the applicable seals [54]:
1) Loosen the bolts [53] that attach the seal [54].
2) Move the seal [54] forward or aft.
3) Tighten the bolts [53].
EFFECTIVITY
 ALL
(d) Retract the aft flap [2] until you can install the rig pins in the bellcranks [12] and flap
carriages [10] (TASK 27-51-00-860-804).
(e) Install the rig pins in the bellcranks [12] and flap carriages [10].
(f) Make sure that the distance between the seals [54] and the aft flap [2] are in the limit.
I. Put the Airplane Back to Its Usual Condition

(a) micrometer (0-1 inch, readable to 1/1000 inch), STD-1096

vernier caliper (0 - 6 inch, readable to 1/1000 inch), STD-1097.
(c) Compare the dimensions you measured with the permitted wear dimensions.
(d) If the parts are not in tolerance, replace or repair the parts.

27-51-23-000-801Outboard Flap Outboard Carriage RemovalPDF p. 2473
2. Outboard Flap Outboard Carriage Removal
(Figure 401)
A. General
(1) This task is applicable to the flap carriages at flap supports No. 1 and 8.
B. References
Reference Title
27-51-00-040-801 Trailing Edge Flap System Deactivation (P/B 201)
27-51-21-000-801 Outboard Trailing Edge Flap Removal (P/B 401)
C. Location Zones
Zone Area
544 Left Wing - Fairing Flap Support No. 1
567 Left Wing - Outboard Flap
644 Right Wing - Fairing Flap Support No. 8
667 Right Wing - Outboard Flap
D. Prepare for the Removal
SUBTASK 27-51-23-040-001
(1) Do this task: Trailing Edge Flap System Deactivation, TASK 27-51-00-040-801.
SUBTASK 27-51-23-020-001
(2) Do this task: Outboard Trailing Edge Flap Removal, TASK 27-51-21-000-801.
E. Outboard Flap Outboard Carriage Removal
SUBTASK 27-51-23-020-002
(1) Remove the nut [13], washer [12], washer [10], bolt [9], and bushing [11] that attach the aft flap
pushrod [16] to the aft flap [3].
SUBTASK 27-51-23-020-003
(2) Remove the bellcrank [19] from the carriage [1]:
NOTE: You can remove the aft flap drive rod and aft flap pushrod with the bellcrank.
(a) Remove the nuts [28], washers [27], bolt [20], and bolt [26] that attach the rub cap [17] to
the bellcrank [19].
(b) Remove the nut [24], washer [23], washer [22], and bolt [21] that attach the bellcrank [19]
to the carriage [1].
EFFECTIVITY
 ALL
(c) Measure and record the distance between the center of the bolt hole in the adjustment
fitting [54] and bellcrank [19].
NOTE: This distance is referred to as Dimension A. This dimension will be used during
the installation of the bellcrank.
SUBTASK 27-51-23-980-001
(3) Manually extend the aft flap [3] away from the main flap [2].
SUBTASK 27-51-23-010-001
(4) Remove the leading edge skin panel [33] from the main flap [2] forward of the carriage [1]:
(a) Remove the bolts [34] that attach the leading edge skin panel [33].
(b) Remove the leading edge skin panel [33] from the main flap [2].
SUBTASK 27-51-23-020-004
(5) Remove the nut [7], washer [6], washer [5], and bolt [4] that attach the failsafe link [15] to the
carriage [1].
(a) Move the failsafe link [15] away from the carriage [1].
SUBTASK 27-51-23-020-005
(6) Remove the carriage [1] from the main flap [2]:
(a) Remove the nut [52], washer [51], bushing [50], washer [49], and bolt [48] that attach the
aft link [35] to the aft link fitting [47].
(b) Remove the nut [36] and washer [37] that attach the aft link [35] to the main flap [2].
(c) Remove the aft link [35] from the aft link fitting [47] and main flap [2].
(d) Remove the nut [30] and washer [31] that attach the forward end of the carriage [1] to the
main flap [2].
(e) Move the carriage [1] forward, away from the main flap [2].
SUBTASK 27-51-23-020-006
(7) If it is necessary, remove the nut [42], washer [43], and washer [44] that attach the failsafe
link [15] to the main flap [2].
SUBTASK 27-51-23-020-007
(8) If it is necessary, remove the aft link fitting [47] from the carriage [1]:
(a) Remove the nuts [41], washers [40], and bolts [39] that attach the aft link fitting [47] to the
carriage [1].
(b) Measure and record the thickness of the shims [46].

SUBTASK 27-51-23-420-019
(1) Inspect the rub pads [125] for wear.
(a) If the rub pads [125] are worn greater than 50%, they will need to be replaced.
SUBTASK 27-51-23-020-008
(2) If it is installed, remove the aft link [35] from the carriage [1].
(a) Remove the nut [52], washer [51], bushing [50], washer [49], and bolt [48] that attach the
aft link [35] to the aft link fitting [47].
SUBTASK 27-51-23-420-001
(3) If it is not installed, install the aft link fitting [47] on the carriage [1]:
(a) Apply sealant, A00247, to the mating surfaces of the shims [46].
(b) Put the shims [46] in their location between the aft link fitting [47] and carriage [1].
NOTE: Use the same thickness of shims that you removed. The maximum total
thickness of the shims is 0.50 in. (12.70 mm). The minimum total thickness of the
shims is 0 in. (0.00 mm).
EFFECTIVITY
 ALL
WARNING
USE NITRILE GLOVES FOR SKIN PROTECTION WHEN YOU USE COR￾BAN 27L. IF IT GETS ON YOUR SKIN, IMMEDIATELY REMOVE IT WITH

PERSONNEL.
(c) Apply Cor-Ban 27L Compound, G50237 (preferred), or corrosion inhibiting material,
G50136 (optional), to the shank and threads of the bolts [39].
(d) Install the bolts [39], washers [40], and nuts [41] to attach the aft link fitting [47] to the
carriage [1].
SUBTASK 27-51-23-420-002
(4) Install the outboard carriage [1] on the main flap [2]:
(a) Put the carriage [1] in its location on the main flap [2], with the forward spindle on the
main flap [2] through the forward bearing [29].
(b) Install the washer [31] and nut [30] that attach the forward end of the carriage [1] to the
main flap [2].
(c) Tighten the nut [30] to 500 in-lb (56.5 N·m) - 700 in-lb (79.1 N·m).
(d) Install the pin [32] in the nut [30].
(e) Install the aft link [35] on the main flap [2] and aft link fitting [47]:
1) Put the aft link [35] in its position on the main flap [2].
a) Make sure that the lubrication fittings on the aft link [35] are on the aft side.
2) Install the bolt [48], washer [49], bushing [50], washer [51], and nut [52] that attach
the aft link [35] to the aft link fitting [47].
3) Install the pin [53] in the nut [52].
4) Install the washer [37] and nut [36] that attach the aft link [35] to the main flap [2].
5) Tighten the nut [36] to 1000 in-lb (113.0 N·m) - 1300 in-lb (146.9 N·m).
6) Install the pin [38] in the nut [36].
SUBTASK 27-51-23-420-003
(5) If it is not installed, install the failsafe link [15] on the main flap [2]:
(a) Put the failsafe link [15] in its position on the main flap [2].
1) Make sure that the slot on the failsafe link [15] is down.
(b) Install the washer [44], washer [43], and nut [42] to attach the failsafe link [15] to the main
flap [2].
(c) Tighten the nut [42] to 270 in-lb (30.5 N·m) - 300 in-lb (33.9 N·m).
(d) Install the cotter pin [45] in the nut [42].
SUBTASK 27-51-23-420-004
(6) Connect the failsafe link [15] to the carriage [1]:
(a) Apply compound, C00528, to the holes in the carriage [1] for the bolt [4].
(b) Install the bolt [4], washer [5], washer [6], and nut [7] that connect the failsafe link [15] to
the carriage [1].
(c) Tighten the nut [7] to 270 in-lb (30.5 N·m) - 300 in-lb (33.9 N·m).
(d) Install the pin [8] in the nut [7].
EFFECTIVITY
 ALL
SUBTASK 27-51-23-410-001
(7) Install the leading edge skin panel [33] on the main flap [2] forward of the carriage [1]:
(a) Put the leading edge skin panel [33] in its location on the leading edge of the main
flap [2].
(b) Apply compound, C00528, to the holes for the bolts [34].
(c) Install the bolts [34] to attach the leading edge skin panel [33].
(d) Apply sealant, A00247, to fill all of the clearances around the leading edge skin panel [33]
that are more than 0.05 in. (1.27 mm).
SUBTASK 27-51-23-420-005
(8) Install the bellcrank [19] on the carriage [1]:
(a) Make sure that the bellcrank [19] is the correct length:
NOTE: The length of the bellcrank can be changed to adjust for lateral trim problems.
1) Measure the distance between the center of the bolt hole in the adjustment
fitting [54] and bellcrank [19].
NOTE: This distance is referred to as Dimension A.
2) Make sure that the Dimension A on the bellcrank [19] you will install is the same as
the bellcrank [19] that you removed.
NOTE: The nominal dimension of the outboard bellcrank is 13.74 in. (349.00 mm).
3) If the bellcrank [19] is not the correct length, adjust the bellcrank [19]:
a) Loosen the nuts [55] on the adjustment fitting [54] until the locking washer [56]
is disengaged from the bellcrank [19].
b) Change the position of the adjustment fitting [54].
c) Engage the locking washer [56] with the bellcrank [19].
d) Tighten the nuts [55] on the adjustment fitting [54].
e) Install MS20995C47 lockwire, G50356, on the nuts [55].
(b) Apply grease, D00633, to the shank of the bolt [21].
1) Make sure that you do not get grease, D00633, on the threads of the bolt [21].
(c) Put the bellcrank [19] in its position on the carriage [1].
(d) Install the bolt [21] and washer [22] that attach the bellcrank [19] to the carriage [1].
(e) Carefully clean all of the grease, D00633, from the threads of the bolt [21].
(f) Install the nut [24] and washer [23] on the bolt [21].

SUBTASK 27-51-23-020-010
(1) Remove the nut [81], washer [80], washer [78], bolt [77], and bushing [79] that attach the aft
flap pushrod [84] to the aft flap [3].
EFFECTIVITY
 ALL
SUBTASK 27-51-23-020-011
(2) Remove the bellcrank [85] from the carriage [71]:
NOTE: You can remove the aft flap drive rod and aft flap pushrod with the bellcrank.
(a) Remove the nuts [96], washers [95], bolt [88], and bolt [94] that attach the rub cap [86] to
the bellcrank [85].
(b) Remove the nut [92], washer [91], washer [90], and bolt [89] that attach the bellcrank [85]
to the carriage [71].
(c) Measure and record the distance between the center of the bolt hole in the adjustment
fitting [122] and bellcrank [85].
NOTE: This distance is referred to as Dimension A. This dimension will be used during
the installation of the bellcrank.
SUBTASK 27-51-23-980-002
(3) Manually extend the aft flap [3] away from the main flap [2].
SUBTASK 27-51-23-010-002
(4) Remove the leading edge skin panel [100] from the main flap [2] forward of the carriage [71]:
(a) Remove the bolts [101] that attach the leading edge skin panel [100].
(b) Remove the leading edge skin panel [100] from the main flap [2].
SUBTASK 27-51-23-020-012
(5) Remove the nut [75], washer [74], washer [73], and bolt [72] that attach the failsafe link [83] to
the carriage [71].
(a) Move the failsafe link [83] away from the carriage [71].

attach the aft link [103] to the aft link fitting [115].
(b) Remove the nut [104] and washer [105] that attach the aft link [103] to the main flap [2].
(c) Remove the aft link [103] from the aft link fitting [115] and main flap [2].
(d) Remove the nut [97] and washer [98] that attach the forward end of the carriage [71] to
the main flap [2].
(e) Move the carriage [71] forward, away from the main flap [2].
SUBTASK 27-51-23-020-014

link [83] to the main flap [2].

to the carriage [71].

(2) If it is installed, remove the aft aft link [103] from the carriage [71].
(a) Remove the nut [120], washer [119], bushing [118], washer [117], and bolt [116] that
attach the aft link [103] to the aft link fitting [115].
SUBTASK 27-51-23-420-008
(3) If it is not installed, install the aft link fitting [115] on the carriage [71]:
(a) Apply sealant, A00247, to the mating surfaces of the shims [114].
(b) Put the shims [114] in their location between the aft link fitting [115] and carriage [71].
NOTE: Use the same thickness of shims that you removed. The maximum total
thickness of the shims is 0.50 in. (12.70 mm). The minimum total thickness of the
shims is 0 in. (0.00 mm).
EFFECTIVITY
 ALL

(e) Install the aft link [103] on the main flap [2] and aft link fitting [115]:

6) Install the pin [106] in the nut [104].

2. Outboard Aft Flap Actuating Mechanism - Removal
(Figure 401)
A. General
(1) This task is applicable to the aft flap actuating mechanism on the inboard flap support and the
outboard flap support on the outboard flap.
B. References
Reference Title
27-51-00-040-801 Trailing Edge Flap System Deactivation (P/B 201)
27-51-00-860-803 Extend the Trailing Edge Flaps (P/B 201)
27-51-28-000-802 Outboard Flap Outboard Support Aft Fairing Removal (P/B 401)
27-51-28-000-804 Outboard Flap Inboard Support Aft Fairing Removal (P/B 401)

Zone Area
567 Left Wing - Outboard Flap
667 Right Wing - Outboard Flap
D. Prepare for the Removal
SUBTASK 27-51-24-860-001
(1) Extend the trailing edge flaps to the 40-unit position (TASK 27-51-00-860-803).
SUBTASK 27-51-24-040-001
(2) Do this task: Trailing Edge Flap System Deactivation, TASK 27-51-00-040-801.
SUBTASK 27-51-24-010-001
(3) Remove the applicable fairing from the outboard flap.
(a) Do this task: Outboard Flap Outboard Support Aft Fairing Removal,
TASK 27-51-28-000-802.
(b) Do this task: Outboard Flap Inboard Support Aft Fairing Removal,
TASK 27-51-28-000-804.
E. Outboard Aft Flap Actuating Mechanism Removal
SUBTASK 27-51-24-020-001
(1) Remove the nut [23], washer [22], washer [20], bolt [19], and bushing [21] that attach the aft
rod assembly [2] to the aft flap [1].
NOTE: When you disconnect the aft rod assembly [2] from the aft flap [1], the aft flap [1] can
move a small distance.
EFFECTIVITY
 ALL
SUBTASK 27-51-24-020-002
(2) Remove the nut [14], washer [13], washer [11], bolt [10], and bushing [12] that attach the
forward rod assembly [16] to the drive rod attach fitting [9].
SUBTASK 27-51-24-020-003
(3) Remove the nuts [7], washers [6], bushings [5], washers [4], and bolts [3] that attach the aft rod
assembly [2] and the forward rod assembly [16] to the bellcrank assembly [17].

(a) Remove the nuts [26] and washers [27] from the bolts [28] that attach the rubcap [25] to
the bellcrank assembly [17].
(b) Remove the nut [32], washer [31], washer [30], and bolt [29] that attach the bellcrank
assembly [17] to the flap carriage [18].
(c) Measure and record the distance between the center of the bolt hole in the adjustment
fitting [36] and bellcrank assembly [17].
NOTE: This distance is referred to as Dimension A.
